summary.name: Prisma Labs
summary.one_liner: Prisma Labs is the company behind the consumer AI photo and video apps Lensa and Prisma, which enhance portraits and turn photos into art styles.
summary.what_it_does: The page is the homepage of Prisma Labs, a company that builds AI photo and video apps. It highlights Lensa AI, which enhances photos, creates perfect portraits, replaces backgrounds and adds effects with a single tap. It also promotes a feature that turns photos into art using hundreds of styles inspired by famous artists. The page states the company was founded in 2016, has over 200M downloads, and that its apps have won an App of the Year award on the App Store and Google Play. It does not describe specific workflows, pricing, or technical details.
notable: Hundreds of art and portrait styles inspired by famous artists
Single-tap portrait enhancement and background replacement
Over 200M downloads, App of the Year winner
caveats: Page does not state pricing or whether features are paid or free
Platform availability is limited to app stores named; no desktop or web version mentioned
